records.name: Kantvilas
records.facts_used: Kantvilas is a Lithuanian two-stem name. Pakerys lists it under Kant-, connected with patience and enduring; Salys lists it under both Kan(t)- and -vil-, linking the latter with viltis, “hope”. The stems are documented, but they need not be expanded into a fixed sentence describing a person. The Senn–Salys dictionary records Kantvilas as a personal name in 1968. Pakerys’s 2010 accentuation study also discusses the exact form and notes differing accentuation in Salys. These are linguistic attestations; the variation in stress does not establish a different calendar date or a coining year.
